recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-22811 follow-up is needed unless the work group later changes the broader Specimen.subject versus Specimen.focus modeling guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-22811 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding BiologicallyDerivedProduct as a choice for Specimen.subject to support lab testing on biologically derived products such as HLA typing for a cord blood unit from a biobank.
initial_application: FHIR-22811's Jira comment says it was applied with FHIR-33081. FHIR-33081 is the same Specimen.subject request and records application in merge commit 7ca1165c668a561e5e3490c975e904909e8b1f13; the underlying source commit 2839a75806d91b52da57faa507124623d0d71085 added the BiologicallyDerivedProduct targetProfile to source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml. No separate FHIR-22811-tagged source commit was found.
additional_context: Specimen and BiologicallyDerivedProduct are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Specimen.focus work, including FHIR-53384, revised subject/focus guidance for cases where the specimen source differs from the subject of record, but it preserved BiologicallyDerivedProduct as an allowed Specimen.subject target. The generic Specimen-subject search parameter uses expression Specimen.subject and has no stale target list that would exclude BiologicallyDerivedProduct. FHIR-33081 already has an audit commit on the combined branch, so it was not republished here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit for FHIR-22811. The current authoritative source already includes targetProfile http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/BiologicallyDerivedProduct in Specimen.subject, and no inconsistent parallel source was found.
